item.title: OpenCap: Human movement dynamics from smartphone videos
item.description:
OpenCap combines video-based pose estimation, machine learning, and biomechanical simulation to estimate human movement and musculoskeletal forces from two or more smartphone cameras.

Scott D. Uhlrich, Antoine Falisse, and Lukas Kidzinski contributed equally to this work.

Read the published paper for the methods, validation, and study limitations.

item.title: Deep neural networks enable quantitative movement analysis using single-camera videos
item.description:
We developed machine learning methods for estimating gait metrics from ordinary single-camera videos of children with cerebral palsy. The work explores how computer vision could make quantitative movement analysis more accessible.

Lukas Kidzinski and Bryan Yang contributed equally to this work.

Read the published paper for the methods, validation, and study limitations.
